name: qa-manager
description: QA management for report-only requirements analysis, PRD review, traceability, risk classification, test strategy, test planning, test case design, defect process, QA reporting, and release sign-off. Use when the user needs a test plan, acceptance coverage, PICT or combinatorial scenario design, regression scope, go/no-go criteria, or an audit-style QA report. Not for writing automated test code — use qa-engineer. Not for running browser, API, or load checks — use qa-tester.
